aboutPage.label: About
aboutPage.title: I'm Will Wu
aboutPage.story1: I studied chemical engineering at Tatung University, then took an MS in Data Analytics Engineering at George Mason University, and started writing backends after graduating.
aboutPage.story2: My first role, at AI-Rider, was maintaining a parking management system and its hardware integrations across more than 1,000 lots in Taiwan. At ChengChi Tech I led a team of four that built a cloud POS and an e-scooter rental system from scratch; at Vocus I contributed to the backend re-architecture of a 2M+ MAU content platform.
aboutPage.story3: Now at APMIC I work on an on-premises LLM platform for enterprises: SSO and permissions, distributed tracing across services, and the data pipelines behind RAG.

measure.title: Measure before concluding
measure.text: Chasing an intermittent production timeout, three plausible hypotheses were each disproven by measurement before the real cause surfaced.

verify.title: Make changes verifiable
verify.text: Before turning a 721-line hand-rolled state machine into 144 lines of declarative flow, I pinned its behaviour with 50 characterization tests.
